name: Anjani Foods Limited
about: Anjani Foods Limited produces and sells bakery products in India. The company offers artisanal cakes, cookies, desserts, pastries, breads, snacks and savories, beverages, appetizers, light meals, and other bakery essentials under the Fresh Choice brand. It also operates retail outlets and bakeries. In addition, the company provides pastries, pizzas, pastas, and sandwiches through its Patisserie cafés. It offers its products through its retail and distribution networks. The company was formerly known as Raasi Enterprises Limited and changed its name to Anjani Foods Limited in November 2014. Anjani Foods Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
